{{Quote|He has decided on a perilous course. To show our resolve by raiding a nearby Trade Federation outpost. His hope is that they'll think twice before challenging us again.|Qui-Gon Jinn, referring to Chewbacca's plan to attack the outpost|audio=OutpostBriefing.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Trade Federation outpost''' was constructed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] to produce [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s for the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. It contained two buildings, a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], both surrounded by a light wall. The outpost was [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|destroyed]] during a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the moon by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] rivals, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] led by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].

==Description==
{{Quote|They're walled in. Attack the wall to bash your way through!|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees during the attack on the outpost|audio=WalledIn.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] outpost was built on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in a small clearing near a [[Water/Legends|river]] during the corporation's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] attempt to colonize the world. The outpost was surrounded by [[Tree/Legends|trees]] on all sides apart from a short clear path to the south that ended at the river, which had to be crossed to access the base. The outpost consisted of a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] in its middle, where [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s were manufactured, and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] that generated energy to speed up the [[Troop/Legends|troop]] center's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] production. A light wall and a gate surrounded the outpost, and four [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] were built on the path to it to alert the Trade Federation of approaching enemies.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|Be careful, they're still making battle droids. Destroy their troop center to shut them down for good!|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees|audio=RipTroopCenter.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The outpost was constructed during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between the Trade Federation and Alaris Prime's rightful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]],<ref name="GB" /> which occurred between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> to provide B1 [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[GWC-04]] with a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of five battle droids. As part of the war, the Trade Federation [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|attacked]] the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], and in response, his [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], planned to drive the company from the moon, choosing the outpost as his first target. In preparation for the attack, the Wookiees made a [[Unidentified Wookiee base (shipyard)|base]] to the south of the outpost, on the other side of the river.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Outpost_attacking.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The outpost was destroyed by a group of Wookiees.]]
When his [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] located the base, Chewbacca crossed the river with a strike force of twelve Wookiees,<ref name="GB" /> including [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]]-wielding [[Bowcaster trooper|troopers]], [[Thermal detonator trooper (Wookiee)|grenade troopers]], and [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]]-riding [[dragon trooper]]s,<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and commenced the [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|attack]]. Acting on the recommendation of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees,<ref name="GB" /> the dragon and grenade [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] brought down the light walls first, as they were far weaker than the large gate. These troops then moved through the breach to destroy the troop center while the bowcaster troopers defeated the five battle droids defending the outpost.<ref name="Prima" /> Chewbacca went on to destroy the Trade Federation's other bases to [[Battle for Alaris Prime|remove]] the company from Alaris Prime.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation outpost was first shown in a preview published on [[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN's]] website on [[October 10]], [[2001]] for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="IGN">{{WebCite|url=http://pc.ign.com/articles/135/135959p1.html|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds|date=2001-10-10|work=[[Wikipedia:IGN|IGN]]|archivedate=20020222012010}}</ref> The outpost was subsequently described in [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> published on [[November 7]], 2001,<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the game itself,<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref>

The outpost appears in "Exploration and Transport," the fifth level of the Attichitcuk campaign, in which the objective is to build an army of Wookiees to destroy the it.<ref name="GB" /> The location of the outpost is revealed on the mini-map from the very start, in order to aid the player while they grasp the game's mechanics; throughout the rest of the game, enemy bases must first be scouted before they appear on the map. The strategy guide states that a few battle droids await the player on the path to the base; however, these droids do not appear in the game.<ref name="Prima" />
